whatIsNewHere.statement: This is the FIRST live institution-web execution under Methodology V2, and the first live institution-web execution this repository has ever performed. Every prior slice built a capability that COULD issue an authorised request and deliberately did not issue one.

boundDraw.drawHashAndFileShaAreNotTheSameValue: drawHash covers the canonical serialization of the draw payload with the drawHash field excluded and is stable under reformatting. artifactFileSha256 covers the committed file bytes. They are reported apart and never conflated. Batch 01 reverifies BOTH, plus the byte length, before it reads a single entry.

scope.whyAHoldoutOrganisationMayBeACQUIREDHere: Acquisition fetches already-public pages under the landed, frozen Phase 2B-1e policy and produces no label, no gold, no classifier output and no semantic reading of any kind. SD2 froze the split assignment BEFORE acquisition precisely so that acquisition could be split-blind. What FINAL_HOLDOUT protects is SEMANTIC access, and holdoutSemanticAccessAuthorised is false in this record and stays false.

read the research database read-only to verify the expected A0 precondition state

whatBatch01MayNotDo: execute any selection index at or above 5
execute or consume any reserve organisation

mutate any A0 or A1 state

frozenNetworkBoundsRestatedNotChanged.statement: Every value below is quoted from the landed, frozen implementation. This record changes none of them, and a change to any of them would require its own ADR and its own measurement.
frozenNetworkBoundsRestatedNotChanged.howTheCeilingsAreDerived: 5 organisations x 1 root each x 60 total requests = 300; 5 x 35 ordinary page attempts = 175. Each of the five drawn organisations carries exactly one WEBSITE_CLAIM authority and zero root promotions, which is what makes 1 root per organisation a fact rather than an assumption.

pilotPauseConditions.P0_AUTHORITY_OR_INPUT_MISMATCH: draw, frame or authority hash mismatch; dry-run root mismatch; unexpected root count, type or id
pilotPauseConditions.P2_ROBOTS_ANOMALY: three consecutive ROBOTS_BLOCKED_ROOT / ROBOTS_UNREADABLE_ROOT, OR more than 40% of the completed five, OR any evidence the robots evaluator behaved inconsistently. A single genuine robots refusal is allowed and is never retried.
pilotPauseConditions.P3_EXECUTION_FAILURE: ANY runTerminalState FAILED, ANY orchestration error, any uncaught CLI or process error after execution began. Deliberately stricter than the future two-consecutive threshold.
pilotPauseConditions.P4_PERSISTENCE_ANOMALY: any expected run, completion or evidence insert missing; any append-only collision that is not an expected idempotency guard; any research write outside the landed tables
pilotPauseConditions.P5_OBVIOUS_LOW_RAW_YIELD: two or more of the five completed organisations have fewer than 4 distinct PRE-SD7 page-evidence responses. EARLY WARNING ONLY - it is NOT the final SD9 decision, because SD7 has not run.
pilotPauseConditions.P6_INVARIANT_OR_HASH_MISMATCH: any draw, frame or batch-record hash fails to recompute
pilotPauseConditions.P7_HOST_STATE_ANOMALY: sleep or wake, pacing-clock discontinuity, or a wall-clock stall inconsistent with normal request timing
onPause: finish and preserve only the current run's durable evidence
do not start the next organisation
write the pause reason into the execution record

noReplacementAndNoSd9DecisionInBatch01.statement: Frozen SD9 defines ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL only AFTER SD7 near-duplicate deduplication. SD7 tooling does not exist and A3 is not authorised, so Batch 01 is structurally unable to reach the SD9 question.

hostSafetyPrecondition.mechanism: the existing OS mechanism (macOS caffeinate), scoped to the batch and never a permanent change to system protections
hostSafetyPrecondition.why: The F5 execution of the 2D2C study was lost to a host clamshell sleep whose symptoms were indistinguishable from institution-side latency. A host stall is NOT institution evidence, and this batch must never record one as though it were.

theOneChangeThisBatchDidMake.change: added exactly two filenames to the `permitted` array of the 'changed no frozen methodology, plan or approval byte' assertion
theOneChangeThisBatchDidMake.why: That assertion diffs the whole of docs/evaluation against the A1 frame commit, so it freezes the directory for every DESCENDANT branch, not only for A1b. A2 descends from A1b and must land its own governance records there. The two A2 filenames were added BY EXACT NAME, the same deliberate, reviewed widening pattern Phase 2B-1c used on the firewall - every other path in docs/evaluation is still refused, and no other assertion in that file was touched.
